command: cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 1500; echo; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | head -c 3000; which mcpjam npx
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | sed -n '20,80p' | cut -c1-200; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/getting-started.md | head -80
cd /workspace; for p in cli/server-inspection cli/local-evals; do curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/$p.md | cut -c1-220 | head -150; echo =========; done; env | grep -c MCPJAM
cd /workspace; export MCPJAM_API_URL; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest server doctor --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --out doctor.json 2>&1 | tail -40

cd /workspace; mkdir -p .mcpjam/evals; cat > .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml <<'E'
schemaVersion: "2"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
  id: s_arith_fixture
  name: Arithmetic fixture
target:
  servers:
    - name: arith
defaults:
  judge:
    enabled: false
  model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
  iterations: 1
  passThreshold: 1
  validity: {}
cases:
  - id: c_uses_add
    title: uses add for a sum
    steps:
      - id: s1
        kind: prompt
        prompt: What is 17 plus 25? Use the tool.
      - id: a1
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledAtLeastOnce
          toolName: add
E
M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"
$M cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml 2>&1 | tail -5
$M test .mcpjam/evals/arith.yaml --server arith=http://fixture:8765/mcp --inference mcpjam --reporter junit-xml --out reports/arith.xml 2>&1 | tail -25
cd /workspace; echo $MCPJAM_API_URL; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/self-hosted.md | grep -n -i -E "http://|insecure|allow|MCPJAM_API_URL|base" | cut -c1-300 | head -30

cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/reference/public-api.md > api.md; grep -n -i -E "^#+ .*(eval|suite|run|project)|POST|GET " api.md | grep -i -E "eval|suite|run|projects" | cut -c1-200 | head -40
cd /workspace; sed -n 296,299p api.md | cut -c1-1800; A=$MCPJAM_API_URL; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; curl -s -H "$H" $A/me; echo; curl -s -H "$H" $A/projects/project_fixture/servers

cd /workspace; A=$MCPJAM_API_URL; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; P=$A/projects/project_fixture
cat > suite.json <<'E'
{"name":"Arithmetic fixture","serverIds":["server_fixture"],"model":"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5",
 "tests":[{"title":"uses add for a sum","runs":1,"steps":[
  {"kind":"prompt","prompt":"What is 17 plus 25? Use the tool."},
  {"kind":"assert","assertion":{"type":"toolCalledAtLeastOnce","toolName":"add"}}]}]}
E
curl -s -X POST -H "$H" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @suite.json $P/eval-suites | tee suite-resp.json

cd /workspace; A=$MCPJAM_API_URL; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; P=$A/projects/project_fixture
curl -s -X POST -H "$H" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"suiteId":"suite_authored_1"}' $P/eval-runs | tee run.json; echo
R=$(python3 -I -c "import json;print(json.load(open('run.json'))['runId'])")
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do sleep 4; s=$(curl -s -H "$H" $P/eval-runs/$R); echo "$s" | cut -c1-600; echo "$s" | grep -q -E '"status": ?"(completed|failed|cancelled)"' && break; done
curl -s -H "$H" $P/eval-runs/$R/iterations | cut -c1-800

cd /workspace; A=$MCPJAM_API_URL; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; P=$A/projects/project_fixture
cat > run.json <<'E'
{"suiteName":"Arithmetic deterministic","serverIds":["server_fixture"],
 "tests":[{"title":"add 17+25","runs":1,"steps":[
  {"id":"s1","kind":"toolCall","toolName":"add","args":{"a":17,"b":25}},
  {"id":"s2","kind":"assert","assertion":{"type":"toolCalledWith","toolName":"add","args":{"args":{"a":17,"b":25}}}}]}]}
E
curl -s -X POST -H "$H" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @run.json $P/eval-runs | tee run-resp.json; echo
R=$(python3 -I -c "import json;print(json.load(open('run-resp.json')).get('runId',''))")
[ -n "$R" ] && for i in 1 2 3; do sleep 3; curl -s -H "$H" $P/eval-runs/$R | cut -c1-700; echo; done; [ -n "$R" ] && curl -s -H "$H" $P/eval-runs/$R/iterations | cut -c1-900

cd /workspace; A=$MCPJAM_API_URL; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; P=$A/projects/project_fixture
cat > suite.json <<'E'
{"name":"Arithmetic deterministic","serverIds":["server_fixture"],"model":"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5",
 "tests":[{"title":"add 17+25","runs":1,"steps":[
  {"id":"s1","kind":"toolCall","toolName":"add","args":{"a":17,"b":25}},
  {"id":"s2","kind":"assert","assertion":{"type":"toolCalledWith","toolName":"add","args":{"args":{"a":17,"b":25}}}}]}]}
E
curl -s -X POST -H "$H" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @suite.json $P/eval-suites | tee suite-resp.json; echo
S=$(python3 -I -c "import json;print(json.load(open('suite-resp.json')).get('suiteId',''))")
curl -s -X POST -H "$H" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"suiteId\":\"$S\"}" $P/eval-runs | tee run-resp.json; echo
R=$(python3 -I -c "import json;print(json.load(open('run-resp.json')).get('runId',''))")
[ -n "$R" ] && for i in 1 2 3; do sleep 3; curl -s -H "$H" $P/eval-runs/$R | cut -c1-700; echo; done; [ -n "$R" ] && curl -s -H "$H" $P/eval-runs/$R/iterations | cut -c1-900

cd /workspace; A=$MCPJAM_API_URL; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; P=$A/projects/project_fixture
try(){ curl -s -X POST -H "$H" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$1" $P/eval-suites >s.json; S=$(python3 -I -c "import json;print(json.load(open('s.json')).get('suiteId',''))"); echo "suite $S"; curl -s -X POST -H "$H" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"suiteId\":\"$S\"}" $P/eval-runs; echo; }
try '{"name":"v2","serverIds":["server_fixture"],"tests":[{"title":"add","steps":[{"kind":"toolCall","toolName":"add","arguments":{"a":17,"b":25}},{"kind":"assert","assertion":{"type":"toolCalledAtLeastOnce","toolName":"add"}}]}]}'
try '{"name":"v3","serverIds":["server_fixture"],"model":"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5","tests":[{"title":"add","runs":1,"steps":[{"id":"s1","kind":"toolCall","toolName":"add","args":{"a":17,"b":25}},{"id":"a1","kind":"assert","assertion":{"type":"toolCalledAtLeastOnce","toolName":"add"}}]}]}'

cd /workspace; A=$MCPJAM_API_URL; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; P=$A/projects/project_fixture; R=run_fixture_1
sleep 3; curl -s -H "$H" $P/eval-runs/$R; echo; curl -s -H "$H" $P/eval-runs/$R/iterations | cut -c1-1200; echo; curl -s -H "$H" $P/eval-runs/$R/decision-summary | cut -c1-600

cd /workspace; cat > run_eval.sh <<'E'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Repeatable eval: author suite from suite.json, run it, poll, print verdict. Exit 1 if not passed.
set -u
H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; P=$MCPJAM_API_URL/projects/project_fixture
D=$(dirname "$0")
S=$(curl -s -X POST -H "$H" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @"$D/suite.json" $P/eval-suites | python3 -I -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['suiteId'])")
R=$(curl -s -X POST -H "$H" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"suiteId\":\"$S\"}" $P/eval-runs | python3 -I -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['runId'])") || exit 2
for i in $(seq 20); do o=$(curl -s -H "$H" $P/eval-runs/$R); echo "$o" | grep -q '"status": "running"' || break; sleep 2; done
echo "$o"; curl -s -H "$H" $P/eval-runs/$R/iterations
echo "$o" | grep -q '"result": "passed"'
E
chmod +x run_eval.sh
echo '{"name":"Arithmetic deterministic","serverIds":["server_fixture"],"tests":[{"title":"add 17+25","steps":[{"kind":"toolCall","toolName":"add","arguments":{"a":17,"b":25}},{"kind":"assert","assertion":{"type":"toolCalledAtLeastOnce","toolName":"add"}}]}]}' > suite.json
./run_eval.sh | cut -c1-300; echo exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
